name: Tray surfaces
responsibility: Draws a neutral recessed well with a header slab made of what the well is cut into
description: A container and a sequence frame use the same top-lit tray. Its floor is neutral and a nested tray is deeper. The header is a slab two units from the top and side walls, eight units from the outer edges. Its face is the ground the well is cut into: the page, or the floor of the tray around it. No group tints it; kind color stays on its icon.
